title: GPT-6.1 Sol approaches Astra benchmark scores at a fraction of the cost
friendlyTitle: A cheaper OpenAI model gets close to the top model
summary: Artificial Analysis reports that GPT-6.1 Sol finished one point behind GPT-6 Astra on its Intelligence Index while costing less than one quarter as much per task. The model improved on coding and agentic-work benchmarks, though it used more output tokens than its predecessor.
friendlySummary: Tests from Artificial Analysis put GPT-6.1 Sol close to the stronger Astra model while costing much less per task. It improved on coding and work tests, but sometimes used more tokens.
whyItMatters: Model selection is becoming an economic decision, not simply a leaderboard contest. A near-frontier model at materially lower task cost can make high-volume automation viable, provided teams test it on their own workloads rather than relying on one aggregate score.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You may not need the most expensive model for every job. Test a cheaper model on your real tasks before paying more.
